title: 30oz stainless mug
text: 30oz stainless mug. I purchased 2 of these.  Supposed to come with 2 different lids and one of them only had one.  Disappointing.  Further, of the double walled stainless mugs I have purchased over the years, these do NOT keep iced drinks iced for as long as others. I would say about 6 hours tops.. the one I had just before this set, at LEAST 24 hours.  Eh.  I replace these about every 2 years or so... these I will probably replace sooner. Eh.  They are 30 oz size.  Do not wash in the dishwasher for longer life.  Came with a couple of stainless straws, I don't use those if they don't have silcone tips because it's kind hard on your teeth... And the missing lid was disappointing.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. I hope this was helpful to you in some way.
